verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents tailnet automation via infrastructure-as-code, webhooks, and other integrations, which could let a background process manage network config autonomously, but there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific automation, scheduling, or autonomous background workflows tailored to an 'AI-native' user. missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-triggered automations, scheduled/autonomous background tasks beyond network config, and independent confirmation of this automation working reliably.
